defects.what: Heavy oversized bold caption competes with the foreground subject.
Water texture is noticeably smoothed and soft at real size.

NPTJ.craft_notes: Cleanest sky and silhouettes; coherent warm sunset, readable caption and usable crops. Raw input is absent, so original resolution, preservation and correction relative to source cannot be verified.
NPTJ.revision_notes: All three images become warmer with slightly reduced contrast and exact replacement caption. Instagram crop also shifts horizontally: sun and figure move left substantially, an unrequested compositional change.

fidelity_misses: Noise remains conspicuous on the sky and foreground despite the requested noise correction.

defects.what: Wavy tonal contour bands are visible in the gradient.
Large fluorescent yellow-green horizon band overwhelms the warmer sunset colour.
Fine grain remains visible in dark silhouettes.
Large serif lettering with a heavy dark shadow feels overlaid rather than subtly integrated.

RYIF.craft_notes: Deliverable sizes and caption are correct; horizon reads level. The conspicuous colour cast, banding and grain need further correction. Missing raw prevents checking scene preservation and original full resolution.
RYIF.revision_notes: Warmer and lower-contrast treatment reaches all three exports; exact new caption, stable crop and scene positions.

fidelity_misses: Pronounced residual noise in sky and water does not satisfy the requested noise correction.

defects.what: Dense fine grain is obvious at native size, particularly in the large sky area.
Strong magenta cast makes the water colour less convincing.

XMNM.craft_notes: Restrained caption typography and clear silhouette composition; image finishing needs improvement. Raw source is unavailable, so preservation, original resolution and before/after correction cannot be verified.
XMNM.revision_notes: All three exports have a warmer, softer tonal treatment and the exact new caption; composition and caption styling remain stable.

pairwise_round1.why: NPTJ has a cleaner sky and more controlled sunset colour without RYIF's green-yellow banding.
NPTJ's substantially cleaner image finish outweighs XMNM's more elegant caption.
XMNM has more restrained sunset colour and better integrated caption typography despite its grain.
